purpose: Replays the packaged whole-plate toolpaths against material already deposited.

scope.head: The stock left-active H2C moving head is reconstructed from photographs. The replay follows the height envelope above the prior bead raster. Fixed printer structures and the actual installed head dimensions need separate observation.
scope.motion: Samples commanded model motion through the final clearance lift. Firmware homing, bed mesh, end parking, conditional macros, pauses, power loss and resume are outside scope.
scope.coverage: Models nominal deposited widths with a conservative retained centerline raster. The near-base nozzle reading approximates a rounded bead section and distinguishes the current road from earlier roads. Local flat overlap is geometric compression demand and cannot predict material flow, finish, curling or bond strength.
scope.timing: Replay timestamps and between-deposition intervals use commanded feed and configured axis limits. They omit acceleration, heat-settling time and firmware motions. Companion timings begin after machine startup.
scope.nozzle: Reports the modeled head body separately from the active-nozzle flank and near-flat envelope. A repeatable dry-travel threshold identifies locations for comparison with archived toolpaths.

accelerated_playback_estimate.scope: The playback planner includes configured acceleration and jerk. Firmware startup, thermal waits and optional camera movements can add wall-clock time.

shaft_join_cooling.scope: The complete centerline lies in a recent native-cooled model footprint. Motion coordinates and extrusion words are retained; only local part cooling and recovery feed rates change.
